name: seed
note: In-distribution: the exact (lint, buggy_code) pairs the riir-clippy seed corpus was built from. The clippy arm's corpus CONTAINS the ground-truth fix, so its quality here measures retrieval, not generalization.

cases.buggy:
fn length(s: &str) -> usize { s.len() }
fn caller(mut s: String) -> usize { length(&mut s) }
cases.want:
fn length(s: &str) -> usize { s.len() }
fn caller(s: String) -> usize { length(&s) }

cases.buggy:
fn take_ref(x: &i32) -> i32 { *x }
fn caller(x: &i32) -> i32 { take_ref(&x) }
cases.want:
fn take_ref(x: &i32) -> i32 { *x }
fn caller(x: &i32) -> i32 { take_ref(x) }
